bio.text: Artemisia Gentileschi was not merely successful. She was famous. The first woman to enter the Accademia del Disegno in Florence, in 1614, Artemisia enjoyed Medici patronage

source.author: Elizabeth Cropper
source.title: Life on the Edge: Artemisia Gentileschi, Famous Woman Painter
source.publisher: Orazio and Artemisia Gentileschi (exh. cat.), The Metropolitan Museum of Art (Internet Archive scan)

bio.text: Artemisia, however, was more celebrated for her portraits, which are of singular merit; they spread her fame over all Europe, and in them she surpassed her father.
